title: Learn love from those who live it
summary: Spiritual companions teach love by drawing close and telling the stories of the all-powerful Beloved.
takeaway: Learn love from the voices that still speak of the Beloved.
lifeApplication: When remembrance goes cold, sit beside someone whose practice still glows and ask one plain question. Let their lived love teach what private guessing cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Companions draw close and speak the Beloved's stories until love has a living voice again.
source.lifeApplication: When longing swells, ask a practiced heart how it keeps speaking of the Beloved with warmth.

evidence.coreClaim: Companions draw close and speak the Beloved's stories until love has a living voice again.
evidence.turn: Let practiced love teach remembrance more deeply than private guessing can.
evidence.practicalImplication: When remembrance goes cold, sit beside someone whose practice still glows and ask one plain question. Let their lived love teach what private guessing cannot.
